evidence: Rewrites USDT functional test framework (test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py) and five USDT tests to run under GDB instead of BCC/eBPF.
rationale: Replacing BCC with GDB removes embedded BPF programs and kernel header dependencies, enabling USDT tests to run locally without root permissions. As noted in the description, this removes 'roughly 660 lines of test and CI code' and reduces ongoing maintenance burden.
